Exam Date & Time: 05-May-2025 (02:30 PM - 05:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  Manipal Institute of Technology, Bengaluru  
  BTech VI Semester  
  End Semester Examination - April / May -2025  
  NEURAL NETWORKS AND DEEP LEARNING [CSE-3273]  
Marks: 50                                                                            Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
1)           Analyze how least-mean-square algorithm minimizes the instantaneous value of the  
  cost function and instantaneous estimate of the weight vector in the neural network.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Compare batch learning and online learning with example.                                  (3)  
  C)      Demonstrate the probability of dichotomies belonging to two different classes using  
  Cover's theorem on separability of patterns.                                              (2)  
  
2)           Apply recursive least-squares estimation for finding the optimal weight vector in the  
  neural network.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Make use of Willshaw von der Malsburg and Kohonen feature mapping models to  
  explain how the neural network can self-organize to create structured feature maps        (3)  
  
  C)      Compare batch mode and stochastic mode of training a multilayer perceptron.               (2)  
3)           Identify the three important essential conditions to ensure the stability conditions of  
  the Hopfield Network.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)  
  
  
  (3)  
  
  
  C)      Outline the gradient descent algorithm and discuss the various types of gradient  
  descent.                                                                                  (2)  
  
4)           Make use of MNIST dataset to write a python program to analyze the performance of  
  the model with dropout and without dropout.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Compare Stochastic gradient descent and Momentum.                                         (3)

C)         Analyze the impact of batch normalization on the generalization performance of  
  neural networks.                                                                      (2)  
  
5)              Identify the role of filters in Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). Make use of  
  CNN to determine the shape of output matrix of an image of size 15 x 15 that uses a  
  (5)  
  padding size of 2, stride size 2, and a 5 x 5 filter.  
  A)  
  B)         Analyze the use of Restricted Boltzmann Machines (RBMs) for implementing the  
  Recommender system.                                                                   (3)  
  
  C)         Identify four different real time applications of using Recurrent Neural Network  
  (RNN).                                                                                (2)
